snippet.title: Inferius | The Horror Game Awards 2026 World Premiere Trailer
snippet.description:
INFERIUS is Inscryption meets Amnesia in a first-person descent through the 9 layers of Hell of Dante’s Inferno. Explore terrifying environments, evade horrors lurking in the dark, and build a Tarot-inspired deck to challenge Hell’s Rulers in strategic card battles. Die, adapt, and descend deeper with every attempt.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS/"---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D
